# API routes and permissions

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_api_routes.py from the live router — do not edit by hand. -->

Every HTTP route the server registers, the minimum role it requires and whether it
writes the audit log. [API.md](API.md) explains request/response shapes for the
commonly used ones; this table is the complete list.

**Gate** — `viewer` / `operator` / `admin`: enforced by `@role_required` before the
handler runs, per cluster when the path names one. `in handler`: the handler resolves
the target first (e.g. which guest, which cluster) and checks the role itself, usually
admin for destructive actions and operator otherwise. `session`: any logged-in user.
`public`: no session needed. With `auth.enabled: false` every gate is open.

305 routes: 163 admin, 28 in handler, 43 operator, 8 public, 20 session, 43 viewer.
